9001.text: Tomorrow at this site: heat index reaches 112°F by 1 PM and storms are likely after 3 PM. Soil is saturated after 2.1 in of rain. An alligator was reported near the east gate. Recommend starting at 6 AM and stopping outdoor work by noon.

9002.text: Tomorrow at this site: a flood warning is in effect until 6 AM after 3.4 in of rain. Expect standing water and soft ground near the river. Hold heavy equipment off low areas until the warning ends.

9003.text: Tomorrow at this site: dry, hot, and windy, with gusts near 22 mph and almost no soil moisture, which raises wildfire risk. Avoid spark-producing work in the afternoon.
